summary.headline: FY26 revenue rose 31% to INR925 crore and EBITDA 35% to INR371 crore, but Q4 revenue fell 13% YoY to INR345 crore.
summary.overview: FY26 revenue reached INR925 crore (+31% YoY) with EBITDA of INR371 crore (40% margin) and PAT of INR271 crore (+22%). Q4 FY26 revenue of INR345 crore was down 13% YoY on execution timing, but up 99% QoQ, and Q4 gross margin rose to 73% from 49%. Order inflow was about INR1,121 crore (+216% YoY), and order book stood at about INR926 crore as of March 2026, or about INR2,062 crore including negotiated and expected orders. Management guided to 20-25% revenue growth in the short term, with EBITDA margins of 38-40%, and says the company remains debt-free with net cash.

financial_highlights.change: +31% YoY vs INR708 crore in FY25

segments.name: Order book (product vs services)
segments.commentary: Order book about INR926 crore as of March 2026 with about INR350 crore services (per analyst). Of the INR1,090 crore negotiated orders, management said about INR100 crore is services and the rest product.

segments.name: Export
segments.commentary: Export order book about INR53 crore. Repeat business from UK continues; a Transportable Precision Approach Radar was exported to a European country with site acceptance testing completed.

guidance_outlook: Revenue growth target of around 20-25% over the short term.
EBITDA margin target of 38-40%, while preserving net cash status.
Negotiated orders of about INR1,090 crore expected to convert into contracts within 1-2 months (government customers, timing not in company control).
Additional single-vendor repeat orders of about INR1,900 crore expected during FY27 on already-delivered products; timing not visible.
Cash conversion cycle expected to settle at 320-340 days; mid-year review planned.
FY26 year-end order book figure to be given at year end; management declined to estimate it now.
capex_capacity: Building about nine floors of additional factory space to add capacity for scaling; capex takes 1-2 years.
Capacity for seekers and other products already built; management says it is avoiding overspending ahead of contract certainty.
Around 1,200 engineers in in-house technology development team.
Product development expensed, not capitalised, in most cases.
demand_pricing: Order inflow FY26 about INR1,121 crore, +216% YoY, across radar, avionics, EW, services and strategic electronics.
BrahMos seeker: first development-seeker variant under execution; production orders expected in about 4-5 months, with delivery requested before next year's middle.
Global OEM inquiries from Europe, with inquiries also from US; contracts expected in 2-4 months, initially development-led.
Management said some lower-margin strategic programme contracts were taken deliberately to build system and programme-management capability; margins cannot be guided contract by contract.
Anti-drone products repositioned from existing radar and ESM; quoting in some locations, no firm revenue timeline.
EW self-protection jammer pods for IAF well received; flight testing next, revenue in medium term; EW suite initiative expected to conclude in about 1 year.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the strong margins and what margin should be expected on the order book?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said margins vary by contract mix; Q4 had no bought-out content, and some earlier strategic contracts were taken at lower margin to build capability. Contract-level margin guidance was not given.

qa_highlights.question: Timing of the INR1,000 crore negotiated orders and the INR1,900 crore repeat orders?
qa_highlights.answer: Negotiated orders expected in 1-2 months; Venkata said negotiated orders now total INR1,090 crore across multiple contracts. INR1,900 crore repeat orders are expected during the year, timing not visible.

qa_highlights.question: Services share and impact on revenue growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Services in negotiated orders about INR100 crore; management maintained 20-25% growth guidance and said repeat orders could add upside.

qa_highlights.question: Cash conversion outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: CCC at 365 days; expected to settle at 320-340 days; mid-year review.

qa_highlights.question: Q4 execution decline and program delays?
qa_highlights.answer: Management denied any delay from its side, attributing timing to customer and government approval processes; Q4 revenue was affected by timing of program execution.

qa_highlights.question: Tejas Mk1A order and Virupaksha radar?
qa_highlights.answer: Tejas avionics quoted, awaiting HAL negotiation; no order in hand. Virupaksha is a DRDO project; the company has its own versions and has not delivered Virupaksha to IAF; no revenue assumed.

risks_watch: Q4 revenue down 13% YoY; execution timing and government approval delays.
Dependence on government customers: timing of INR1,090 crore negotiated and INR1,900 crore repeat orders is not in company control.
Services share of order book (about 38%) and its effect on near-term revenue conversion.
Cash conversion cycle still at 365 days; operating cash flow weak in the last two years per analyst.
BrahMos seeker production order timing; management says no revenue impact expected even if delayed.
Management declined to give FY26 year-end order book number or contract-level margins.
summary.management_tone: Confident and bullish on long-term scale and export opportunity, but cautious and evasive on near-term timing, order book size and specific programmes. Management repeatedly declined to quantify timelines and disputed some analyst characterisations of delays.
key_quotes: We continue to target revenue growth of around 20%, 25% over the short term while maintaining healthy EBITDA margins of 38% to 40% and preserving our net cash status.
The cash conversion cycle today is at 365 days.
Once there the execution is completed, I think in the next 4, 5 months' time, the production orders would start coming in.

adds.what: About nine floors of additional factory space to add capacity for scaling

growth.why: Management targets 20-25% revenue growth over the short term with 38-40% EBITDA margins, backed by a FY26 order book of about INR926 crore and INR1,121 crore order inflow (+216%), plus INR1,090 crore negotiated orders expected to convert in 1-2 months; the nine-floor factory build takes 1-2 years, so it adds little near-term capacity.
